def slice_to_patch_channels16(slice):
    """Convert a 2D slice into 16x16 patch channels.
    返回 (256, H/16, W/16)，256 = 16*16。
    等价实现（实测形状确证）：
      s.reshape(B,C,H//16,16,W//16,16).permute(0,1,3,5,2,4).reshape(B,-1,H//16,W//16)
    """
    ...

def patch_channels16_to_slice(patch_channels):
    """Convert 16x16 patch channels back into a 2D slice.
    (256, H/16, W/16) -> (1, H, W)
    """
    ...

def apply_pads_to_slice(slice, pads):

def parse_pads_from_stem(stem):

    格式："{idx:05d}_l{left}_r{right}_u{up}_d{down}"
    返回：(idx, left, right, up, down)
    """
    ...

def parse_shape_from_stem(stem):
